Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_blackmetal_sr_or.Name: WID_Edged_Scythe_BlackMetal_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_blackmetal_sr_or.Description: Scythe: Black Metal. Deals moderate damage and heavy impact in a wide arc.  Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_assault_autodrum_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_AutoDrum_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_autodrum_sr_ore_t04.Description: SMG. Mid ranged SMG with a high capacity magazine and a lateral kick. Its shooting profile makes it ideal for clearing groups of nearby enemies in mobile engagements.

Weapon:wid_assault_doubleshot_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_Doubleshot_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_doubleshot_sr_ore_t04.Description: Assault Weapon: Burst Semi-Automatic. Fires a highly accurate two bullet burst, capable of dealing good damage at long range. Can throw lead downrange very quickly, but rewards careful aim with increased headshot damage.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_medieval_vr_ore_.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Medieval_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_medieval_vr_ore_.Description: Hardware: Medieval. A hefty spiked hammer with high impact and a moderate attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_assault_fleming_sr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Assault_Fleming_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_assault_fleming_sr_ore_t03.Description: Assault Rifle: Spec Ops.  A high powered semi-automatic rifle with a small magazine that is most accurate when fired in short bursts.

Weapon:wid_smg_bone_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_SMG_bone_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_smg_bone_sr_ore_t05.Description: Wild-firing submachine gun. While this weapon is held, wildlife will not attack unless provoked.

Weapon:wid_pistol_boltrevolver_r_ore_t03.Name: WID_Pistol_BoltRevolver_R_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_pistol_boltrevolver_r_ore_t03.Description: Pistol: Bolt Revolver. Fires high-powered bolts that can pierce through multiple enemies. Accurate when fired slowly, and cheap to operate.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_steampunk_sr_ore.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Steampunk_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_steampunk_sr_ore.Description: Hardware: Steampunk. A hammer that delivers a hefty punch with slow, wide swings. Steampunk Smash: Heavy attack that slams the ground damaging enemies around it.

Weapon:wid_pistol_firecracker_r_ore_t03.Name: WID_Pistol_FireCracker_R_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_pistol_firecracker_r_ore_t03.Description: Pistol: Special. Launches firecrackers that bounce off walls, and will knockback and damage enemies in a small radius when they explode.

Weapon:wid_blunt_medium_r_crystal_t04.Name: WID_Blunt_Medium_R_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_medium_r_crystal_t04.Description: Hardware: Medium. A heavy wrench with a moderate swing rate and good knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_heavy_dragon_sr_.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Heavy_Dragon_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_heavy_dragon_sr_.Description: Hardware: Heavy. A slow-swinging hammer that deals fire damage with powerful knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_vr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Sniper_Standard_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_vr_ore_t04.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic. An accurate mid to long range rifle that deals good damage. Can be fired quickly in an emergency, but at significantly reduced accuracy.

Weapon:wid_sniper_fleming_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Sniper_Fleming_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_sniper_fleming_vr_ore_t02.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Spec Ops. A powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_light_c_ore_t02.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Light_C_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_light_c_ore_t02.Description: Sword: Light. An extremely fast swing speed gives this blade great sustained damage, but minimal stagger potential. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_assault_neonglow_lmg_sr_ore_t.Name: WID_Assault_NeonGlow_LMG_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_assault_neonglow_lmg_sr_ore_t.Description: Assault Rifle: Neon. A high damage light machine gun that's good for sustained fire due to the moderate rate of fire and huge magazine size. Very inaccurate when firing on the move. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.

Weapon:wid_explosive_fleming_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Explosive_Fleming_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_explosive_fleming_sr_ore_t04.Description: Explosive Weapon: Grenade Launcher - Spec Ops. Uses explosive ammo to shoot proximity grenades that damage groups of enemies in a moderate radius when they explode.

Weapon:wid_pistol_boombox_sr_crystal_t05.Name: WID_Pistol_Boombox_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_boombox_sr_crystal_t05.Description:
Pistol. Boombox.
Fires a pair of Sonic Blasts that pierce enemies.
Boasts a large clip size with low recoil.
This Hot Mix will really get your feet moving.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_military_vr_crystal_t.Name: WID_Shotgun_Military_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_shotgun_military_vr_crystal_t.Description: Shotgun: Tactical Semi-Automatic - Military. Rapid fire military shotgun with tight spread but stiff recoil. Good for dealing a lot of damage very quickly, but expect to reload often.

Weapon:wid_sniper_hydraulic_bow_sr_ore_t.Name: WID_Sniper_Hydraulic_Bow_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_hydraulic_bow_sr_ore_t.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Hydraulic. Fires an arrow that drops over time and deals high impact damage in an 0.5 tile radius.  Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_scavenger_sr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Scavenger_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_scavenger_sr_ore_t0.Description: Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_heavy_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Heavy_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_heavy_sr_ore_t02.Description: Hardware: Heavy. A slow-swinging hammer with powerful knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_assault_auto_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Assault_Auto_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_assault_auto_vr_ore_t01.Description: Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. Flexible assault rifle capable of handling all types of combat scenarios. High rate of fire with solid accuracy when aiming down sights and firing in controlled bursts.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_r_ore_t03.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Light_R_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_r_ore_t03.Description: Axe: Light. A very fast improvised axe with fair damage and knockback. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_boombox_vr_cryst.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Boombox_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_boombox_vr_cryst.Description: Hardware: Boombox. A hammer with good attack speed and excellent impact. Bass Drop: Smash the ground, creating a series of sonic pulses that damage and knockback enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_scavenger_bow_sr_cryst.Name: WID_Sniper_Scavenger_Bow_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_scavenger_bow_sr_cryst.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Scavenger. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_vr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Assault_SingleShot_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_vr_ore_t03.Description: Assault Weapon: Slug Gun. A rifle that fires slugs with high damage and impact. Good accuracy, but relatively slow rate of fire, and high per-bullet cost.

Weapon:wid_explosive_launcher_military_s.Name: WID_Explosive_Launcher_Military_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_explosive_launcher_military_s.Description: Explosive Weapon: Military. Shoots rockets that explode into a pool of fire for a short duration, damaging and stunning enemies inside. Launches up to 4 rockets before needing to reload.

Weapon:wid_assault_hydra_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Assault_Hydra_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_assault_hydra_sr_ore_t02.Description: Assault Weapon: Hydraulic. A hybrid weapon that fires a tight cluster of pellets, with considerably more knockback than an assault rifle, but better range and more focused damage than a shotgun.

Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_scope_vr_crys.Name: WID_Sniper_Standard_Scope_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_scope_vr_crys.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic. A mid to long range rifle that deals good damage and can be fired quickly. Scoped for additional down sights accuracy.

Weapon:wid_assault_auto_founders_sr_ore_.Name: WID_Assault_Auto_Founders_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_assault_auto_founders_sr_ore_.Description:
Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. Flexible assault rifle capable of handling all types of combat scenarios. High rate of fire with solid accuracy when aiming down sights and firing in controlled bursts.

"Don't worry, we'll give you a running start." - Ramirez

Weapon:wid_blunt_boxing_glove_club_r_ore.Name: WID_Blunt_Boxing_Glove_Club_R_Ore_T03

Weapon:wid_pistol_fleming_scoped_sr_crys.Name: WID_Pistol_Fleming_Scoped_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_fleming_scoped_sr_crys.Description: Pistol: Spec Ops.  A scoped revolver dealing high damage at a slow rate of fire with a limited magazine size.

Weapon:wid_sniper_steampunk_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Sniper_Steampunk_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_sniper_steampunk_vr_ore_t01.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic - Steampunk. A relatively fast and powerful mid range sniper rifle.

Weapon:wid_smg_bone_vr_ore_t05.Name: WID_SMG_bone_VR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_smg_bone_vr_ore_t05.Description: Wild-firing submachine gun. While this weapon is held, wildlife will not attack unless provoked.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_standard_r_ore_t01.Name: WID_Shotgun_Standard_R_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_shotgun_standard_r_ore_t01.Description: Shotgun: Pump-Action. Deals high damage and knockback at a moderate fire rate. Short range and limited magazine size.

Weapon:wid_assault_invasion_pulserifle_s.Name: WID_Assault_Invasion_PulseRifle_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_assault_invasion_pulserifle_s.Description: Fully Automatic when hip-fired, slower shots and extra headshot damage when aimed down sights.

Weapon:wid_assault_smg_unsilenced_milita.Name: WID_Assault_SMG_Unsilenced_Military_R_Ore_T04

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_dragon_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Dragon_SR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_assault_auto_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Assault_Auto_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_assault_neonglow_lmg_vr_ore_t.Name: WID_Assault_NeonGlow_LMG_VR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_sniper_shredder_sr_crystal_t0.Name: WID_Sniper_Shredder_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_shredder_sr_crystal_t0.Description: Sniper Rifle: Cluster. Hybrid shotgun-sniper that fires tight groupings of pellets that deal heavy damage. Has a large magazine size, and fair accuracy at long range.

Weapon:wid_pistol_artdeco_vr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Pistol_ArtDeco_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_pistol_artdeco_vr_ore_t03.Description: Pistol: Art Deco.  A slow firing but heavy hitting pistol with a limited ammo capactiy.

Weapon:wid_assault_semiauto_c_ore_t01.Name: WID_Assault_SemiAuto_C_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_assault_semiauto_c_ore_t01.Description: Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. A versatile rifle that rewards careful aim with high headshot damage, but can be fired very rapidly in a pinch.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_r_ore_t01.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_R_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_r_ore_t01.Description: Spear: Medium. Delivers high damage and moderate knockback and a slow attack speed. Overhead Swipe: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_ou_uc_ore_t03.Name: WID_Shotgun_Break_OU_UC_Ore_T03

Weapon:wid_shotgun_auto_r_ore_t03.Description: Shotgun: Automatic. Combines a fast fire rate, decent damage, and large magazine to create an excellent weapon for dealing with multiple targets at close range.

Weapon:wid_explosive_artdeco_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Explosive_ArtDeco_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_explosive_artdeco_sr_ore_t02.Description: Explosive Weapon: Art Deco.  Fires long-range rockets that damage and knockback groups of enemies in a moderate radius.

Weapon:wid_edged_airplane_axe_vr_crystal.Name: WID_Edged_Airplane_Axe_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_edged_airplane_axe_vr_crystal.Description: Axe: Light - Holiday Fun. A light axe with a good balance of damage and impact. Jet-Fueled Blast: Slashes twice and finishes with a thrust that damages and knocks back enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_steampunk_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Sniper_Steampunk_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_sniper_steampunk_sr_ore_t01.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic - Steampunk. A relatively fast and powerful mid range sniper rifle.

Weapon:wid_sniper_hydraulic_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Sniper_Hydraulic_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_sniper_hydraulic_vr_ore_t02.Description: Sniper Rifle: Hydraulic. An accurate semi-auto rifle that deals good damage and very high knockback.

Weapon:wid_sniper_vindertech_bow_sr_crys.Name: WID_Sniper_Vindertech_Bow_SR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_sniper_crossbow_military_sr_o.Description: Sniper Rifle: Crossbow - Military. Fires an arrow that drops over time and pierces through enemies.

Weapon:wid_blunt_shovel_halloween_sr_ore.Name: WID_Blunt_Shovel_Halloween_SR_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_dragon_r_ore_t03.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Dragon_R_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_dragon_r_ore_t03.Description: Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high fire damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

Weapon:wid_assault_lmg_r_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_LMG_R_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_lmg_r_ore_t04.Description: Assault Weapon: Light Machine Gun. A heavy weapon with high damage, an extreme rate of fire, and a huge magazine size. Very inaccurate unless aiming down sights from a fixed position, and firing in short bursts.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_vr_crystal_t04.Name: WID_Shotgun_Break_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_vr_crystal_t04.Description: Shotgun: Double-Barreled. Deals heavy damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a very wide cone. Has extremely limited range, tiny ammo capacity, and a long reload time.

Weapon:wid_pistol_paper_airplane_sr_crys.Name: WID_Pistol_Paper_Airplane_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_pistol_paper_airplane_sr_crys.Description: Pistol: Holiday Fun. A pistol that uses shells 'n' slugs to launch a slow-moving paper airplane that damages enemies in a moderate radius when it explodes.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_heavy_vacuumtube_vr.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Heavy_VacuumTube_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_heavy_vacuumtube_vr.Description: Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that is also good at stunning enemies. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.

Weapon:wid_pistol_winter_gingerbread_vr_.Name: WID_Pistol_Winter_GingerBread_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_pistol_winter_gingerbread_vr_.Description: Pistol: Winter. A potent and quick revolver with modest recoil.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_auto_founders_vr_ore_.Name: WID_Shotgun_Auto_Founders_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_shotgun_auto_founders_vr_ore_.Description: Shotgun: Automatic. Combines a fast fire rate, decent damage, and large magazine to create an excellent weapon for dealing with multiple targets at close range.

Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_scope_vr_ore_.Name: WID_Sniper_Standard_Scope_VR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_scope_vr_ore_.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic. A mid to long range rifle that deals good damage and can be fired quickly. Scoped for additional down sights accuracy.

Weapon:wid_pistol_dragon_vr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Pistol_Dragon_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_pistol_dragon_vr_ore_t04.Description: Pistol: Special. Part double-barrel shotgun, part pistol, and part DRAGON. Fires a wide blast of pellets at close range for extreme damage and knockback. Slow to reload.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_standard_vt_vr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Shotgun_Standard_VT_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_shotgun_standard_vt_vr_ore_t0.Description: Shotgun: Energy. Fires an explosive ball of plasma that does high damage over a small area. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.

Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_r_ore_t02.Name: WID_Assault_SingleShot_R_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_r_ore_t02.Description: Assault Weapon: Slug Gun. A rifle that fires slugs with high damage and impact. Good accuracy, but relatively slow rate of fire, and high per-bullet cost.

Weapon:wid_assault_shockwave_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_Shockwave_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_shockwave_sr_ore_t04.Description: Assault Rifle: Shoots highly accurate energized rounds at a moderate rate for high sustained damage. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_bow_sr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Sniper_Medieval_Bow_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_bow_sr_ore_t0.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Medieval. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range and velocity increase with charge time.

Weapon:wid_launcher_rocket_dragon_sr_ore.Name: WID_Launcher_Rocket_Dragon_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_launcher_rocket_dragon_sr_ore.Description: Explosive Weapon: Fires long-range rockets that create a lingering series of fiery explosions. Perfect for denying husk entry in a chokepoint! Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

Weapon:wid_assault_steampunk_drum_vr_ore.Name: WID_Assault_Steampunk_Drum_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_assault_steampunk_drum_vr_ore.Description: Assault Rifle: Steampunk. A high damage assault rifle that's good for sustained fire due to the slow rate of fire and large magazine capacity. Not very accurate when firing on the move.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_uc_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Heavy_UC_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_uc_ore_t01.Description: Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.

Weapon:wid_pistol_fleming_scoped_sr_ore_.Name: WID_Pistol_Fleming_Scoped_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_pistol_fleming_scoped_sr_ore_.Description: Pistol: Spec Ops.  A scoped revolver dealing high damage at a slow rate of fire with a limited magazine size.

Weapon:wid_sniper_scavenger_vr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Sniper_Scavenger_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_sniper_scavenger_vr_ore_t03.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_assault_burst_vr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Assault_Burst_VR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_assault_burst_vr_ore_t05.Description: Assault Weapon: Burst. An assault rifle that fires tight bursts that allow for precise targeting in mobile mid-range engagements. Deals good damage, but consumes its magazine very quickly.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_laser_vr_ore_t.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Laser_VR_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_sniper_vacuumtube_bow_sr_ore_.Name: WID_Sniper_VacuumTube_Bow_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_medium_r_crystal_.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Medium_R_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_medium_r_crystal_.Description: Sword: Medium. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with low impact. Cut and Thrust: A series of three heavy attacks that cut twice and thrust once while moving forward.

Weapon:wid_pistol_medieval_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Pistol_Medieval_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_medieval_sr_ore_t05.Description: Pistol: Medieval. Deals high burst damage, with a high critical chance.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_medium_laser_foun.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Medium_Laser_Founders_R_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_pistol_auto_retroscifi_vr_ore.Description: SMG: Retro Sci-Fi. A fast firing SMG, good for run and gun situations. Suffers from poor accuracy at medium and long range.

Weapon:wid_assault_medieval_smg_sr_cryst.Description: SMG: Medieval. Deals consistent damage to enemies at close to medium range, but falls off at longer ranges due to lower accuracy.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_military_sr_crystal_t.Name: WID_Shotgun_Military_SR_Crystal_T05

Weapon:wid_shotgun_tactical_r_ore_t01.Name: WID_Shotgun_Tactical_R_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_shotgun_tactical_r_ore_t01.Description: Shotgun: Tactical. Precise pump shotgun that can deal good damage at medium range. Slow fire rate and limited magazine size.

Weapon:wid_pistol_pirate_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Pistol_Pirate_SR_Ore_T04

Weapon:wid_pistol_space_sr_crystal_t04.Description: Pistol: High Tech. Rapidly fires lasers that bounce off walls, are effective at long range, and can pierce through multiple enemies. Deals energy damage that is fairly effective against elemental enemies.

Weapon:wid_blunt_heavy_flintlock_r_ore_t.Name: WID_Blunt_Heavy_Flintlock_R_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_blunt_heavy_flintlock_r_ore_t.Description: Club: Heavy - Flintlock. A heavy club with a slow swing speed and large knockback potential. Home Run: Heavy attack focused on impact and a knockback that will send enemies flying.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_hydraulic_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Shotgun_Hydraulic_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_shotgun_hydraulic_sr_ore_t04.Description: Shotgun: Hydraulic. Very accurate pump shotgun that can reliably hit targets at medium range. Deals high impact but moderate damage at a slow fire rate.

Weapon:wid_launcher_wintergrenade_sr_ore.Name: WID_Launcher_WinterGrenade_SR_Ore_T03

Weapon:wid_pistol_handcannon_r_crystal_t.Name: WID_Pistol_Handcannon_R_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_shotgun_tactical_founders_sr_.Name: WID_Shotgun_Tactical_Founders_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_vr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Shotgun_Break_VR_Ore_T04

Weapon:wid_pistol_gatling_sr_crystal_t05.Description: SMG: Special. Absurdly fast-firing SMG with a large magazine that dishes out ridiculous damage at short to mid-range. Offset by poor accuracy, extreme ammo consumption, and a brief spin-up time before firing.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Heavy_SR_Ore_T04

Weapon:wid_assault_surgical_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Assault_Surgical_SR_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Light_SR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_assault_auto_founders_sr_crys.Name: WID_Assault_Auto_Founders_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_auto_founders_sr_crys.Description:
Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. Flexible assault rifle capable of handling all types of combat scenarios. High rate of fire with solid accuracy when aiming down sights and firing in controlled bursts.

"Don't worry, we'll give you a running start." - Ramirez

Weapon:wid_shotgun_ratrod_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Shotgun_RatRod_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_shotgun_ratrod_vr_ore_t02.Description: Shotgun: Burst - Rat Rod. A fast firing shotgun that shoots in double bursts. Effective at decimating large targets at mid range.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_rocket_vr_crysta.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Rocket_VR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_ratrod_vr_ore.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Light_RatRod_VR_Ore_T04

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_pirate_sr_crystal.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Pirate_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_pirate_sr_crystal.Description: Sword: Medium - Flintlock. A deadly cutlass that combines a good mix of damage and impact with exceptional crit. Best when paired with pistols. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_assault_invasion_pulserifle_s.Name: WID_Assault_Invasion_PulseRifle_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_invasion_pulserifle_s.Description: Fully Automatic when hip-fired, slower shots and extra headshot damage when aimed down sights.

Weapon:wid_sniper_neon_bow_sr_crystal_t0.Name: WID_Sniper_Neon_Bow_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_neon_bow_sr_crystal_t0.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Neon. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time. Arrow pierces through targets.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_laser_vr_ore_t.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Laser_VR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_laser_vr_ore_t.Description: Spear: High Tech. Energized trident with slow swing speed, high damage, and moderate knockback. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_boombox_sr_ore.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Boombox_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_boombox_sr_ore.Description: Spear: Boombox. A spear that deals heavy damage with long range thrusting attacks. Sonic Pulse: Slam the spear into the ground, channeling damage and knocking back nearby enemies while also providing a temporary damage buff to you and your allies. Stacks up to 4 times.

Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_uc_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Scythe_UC_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_uc_ore_t01.Description: Scythe: Improvised. A slow weapon that deals high damage and moderate impact. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_light_r_ore_t04.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Light_R_Ore_T04

Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_winter_sr_ore.Name: WID_Sniper_Standard_Winter_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_winter_sr_ore.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic. A mid to long range rifle that deals good damage and can be fired quickly. Scoped for additional down sights accuracy.

Weapon:wid_assault_smg_invasion_raygun_s.Name: WID_Assault_SMG_Invasion_Raygun_SR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_assault_surgical_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Assault_Surgical_VR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_shotgun_standard_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Shotgun_Standard_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_shotgun_standard_vr_crystal_t.Name: WID_Shotgun_Standard_VR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_pistol_medieval_vr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Pistol_Medieval_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_pistol_medieval_vr_ore_t03.Description: Pistol: Medieval. Deals high burst damage, with a high critical chance.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_artdeco_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Shotgun_ArtDeco_VR_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_pistol_stormking_sr_crystal_t.Name: WID_Pistol_Stormking_SR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_pistol_semiauto_c_ore_t01.Name: WID_Pistol_SemiAuto_C_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_ou_vr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Shotgun_Break_OU_VR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_shotgun_artdeco_break_vr_ore_.Name: WID_Shotgun_ArtDeco_Break_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_shotgun_artdeco_break_vr_ore_.Description: Shotgun: Art Deco.  Heavy hitting shotgun that deals damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a short, wide cone.  Suffers from a tiny ammo capacity and long reload time.

Weapon:wid_sniper_scavenger_vr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Sniper_Scavenger_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_scavenger_vr_ore_t04.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_laser_vr_ore_t.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Laser_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_laser_vr_ore_t.Description: Spear: High Tech. Energized trident with slow swing speed, high damage, and moderate knockback. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_heavy_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Shotgun_Heavy_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_shotgun_heavy_sr_ore_t05.Description: Shotgun: Heavy. A semi-automatic shotgun with a quick rate of fire, strong knockback, a large magazine, and decent range.

Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_uc_ore_t03.Name: WID_Edged_Scythe_UC_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_uc_ore_t03.Description: Scythe: Improvised. A slow weapon that deals high damage and moderate impact. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.

Weapon:wid_sniper_dragon_sr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Sniper_Dragon_SR_Ore_T03

Weapon:wid_shotgun_steampunk_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Shotgun_Steampunk_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_shotgun_steampunk_sr_ore_t02.Description: Shotgun: Double-Barreled - Steampunk. Fires two slugs with reasonable accuracy and range, but has tiny ammo capacity and a long reload time.

Weapon:wid_smg_fleming_burstfire_sr_ore_.Name: WID_SMG_Fleming_BurstFire_SR_Ore_T04

Weapon:wid_blunt_shovel_halloween_sr_ore.Description: A creepy round-point shovel that looks like it has been used to dig up terrible secrets. The shovel handles like a lighter sledge hammer, with a better damage and less impact. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_pistol_sixshooter_c_ore_t01.Name: WID_Pistol_SixShooter_C_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_pistol_sixshooter_c_ore_t01.Description: Pistol: Revolver. Fast, precise sidearm, with a good punch but small capacity.

Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_bow_sr_crysta.Name: WID_Sniper_Medieval_Bow_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_bow_sr_crysta.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Medieval. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range and velocity increase with charge time.

Weapon:wid_blunt_light_c_ore_t02.Name: WID_Blunt_Light_C_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_blunt_light_c_ore_t02.Description: Club: Light. A simple baseball bat with a fast swing speed but low damage and knockback. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.

Weapon:wid_sniper_boltaction_scope_r_ore.Name: WID_Sniper_BoltAction_Scope_R_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_sniper_boltaction_scope_r_ore.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action. Powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies.

Weapon:wid_pistol_artdeco_sr_crystal_t05.Name: WID_Pistol_ArtDeco_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_artdeco_sr_crystal_t05.Description: Pistol: Art Deco.  A slow firing but heavy hitting pistol with a limited ammo capactiy.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_halloween_sr_ore_.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Halloween_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_halloween_sr_ore_.Description: Sword: Medium. Uses an above average attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with moderate impact. Spectral Slash: Warp to the targeted enemy, dealing heavy damage. May stagger smaller enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_tripleshot_vr_crystal_.Name: WID_Sniper_TripleShot_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_tripleshot_vr_crystal_.Description: Sniper Rifle: Burst. Fires accurate three-round bursts, dealing very high damage, but consuming ammo quickly.

Weapon:wid_assault_boombox_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Assault_Boombox_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_assault_boombox_vr_ore_t01.Description: Assault Rifle: Boombox. A higher than average impact assault rifle that fires two shot bursts at a steady rate and pierces enemies.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_artdeco_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_ArtDeco_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_artdeco_vr_ore_t02.Description: Axe: Medium - Art Deco.  Versatile weapon that combines a moderate swing speed with good damage and knockback.  Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.

Weapon:wid_blunt_heavy_flintlock_vr_ore_.Name: WID_Blunt_Heavy_Flintlock_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_blunt_heavy_flintlock_vr_ore_.Description: Club: Heavy - Flintlock. A heavy club with a slow swing speed and large knockback potential. Home Run: Heavy attack focused on impact and a knockback that will send enemies flying.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vr_ore_t02.Description: Spear: Heavy. Delivers high damage and moderate knockback and a slow attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Shotgun_Break_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_vr_ore_t01.Description: Shotgun: Double-Barreled. Deals heavy damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a very wide cone. Has extremely limited range, tiny ammo capacity, and a long reload time.

Weapon:wid_assault_doubleshot_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Assault_Doubleshot_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_assault_doubleshot_vr_ore_t02.Description: Assault Weapon: Burst Semi-Automatic. Fires a highly accurate two bullet burst, capable of dealing good damage at long range. Can throw lead downrange very quickly, but rewards careful aim with increased headshot damage.

Weapon:wid_assault_hydraulic_drum_vr_cry.Name: WID_Assault_Hydraulic_Drum_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_hydraulic_drum_vr_cry.Description: Assault Weapon: Hydraulic. A slow firing high impact automatic rifle with a large magazine.

Weapon:wid_assault_semiauto_steampunk_sr.Name: WID_Assault_SemiAuto_Steampunk_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_assault_semiauto_steampunk_sr.Description: Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic - Steampunk. A versatile rifle that deals steady damage.

Weapon:wid_pistol_fleming_tactical_vr_or.Name: WID_Pistol_Fleming_Tactical_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_pistol_fleming_tactical_vr_or.Description: Pistol: Spec Ops.  A semi-automatic sidearm with moderate damage, good rate of fire and a moderate magazine size that is most accurate when fired in short bursts.

Weapon:wid_pistol_revolver_singleaction_.Name: WID_Pistol_Revolver_SingleAction_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_pistol_revolver_singleaction_.Description: Pistol: Revolver. Mid-range revolver with a limited magazine but excellent headshot damage. Slow and precise when aiming downsights, or can be rapidly fired from the hip for a more damaging, less accurate spray of bullets.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_boombox_break_vr_crys.Name: WID_Shotgun_Boombox_Break_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_shotgun_boombox_break_vr_crys.Description: Shotgun: Boombox. Shoots sonic blasts at enemies in a mid-ranged cone, damaging and knocking them back. Maintains a good balance of fire rate, clip size, and reload time, exchanging some damage for excellent impact.

Weapon:wid_pistol_semiauto_founders_vr_o.Name: WID_Pistol_SemiAuto_Founders_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_pistol_semiauto_founders_vr_o.Description: Pistol: Semi-Automatic. Versatile sidearm with moderate damage, good rate of fire and large magazine.

Weapon:wid_assault_vacuumtube_vr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_VacuumTube_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_vacuumtube_vr_ore_t04.Description: Assault Weapon: A semi-automatic electrical rifle with good accuracy. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_ratrod_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Shotgun_RatRod_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_shotgun_ratrod_sr_ore_t01.Description: Shotgun: Burst - Rat Rod. A fast firing shotgun that shoots in double bursts. Effective at decimating large targets at mid range.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_medieval_vr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Medieval_VR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_medieval_vr_ore_t05.Description: Axe: Medieval. A large curved axe with a good mix of damage and impact. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_smg_fleming_burstfire_vr_ore_.Name: WID_SMG_Fleming_BurstFire_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_smg_fleming_burstfire_vr_ore_.Description: SMG: Spec Ops.  An automatic SMG that fires in 4 round bursts and is most accurate when fired in short bursts.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_semiauto_scavenger_sr.Name: WID_Shotgun_SemiAuto_Scavenger_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_shotgun_semiauto_scavenger_sr.Description: Shotgun: Semi-Automatic. Fast-firing shotgun with a large magazine. Good for dealing with multiple targets at short range. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_blunt_scavenger_vr_crystal_t0.Name: WID_Blunt_Scavenger_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_scavenger_vr_crystal_t0.Description: Hardware: Light. An improvised pipe weapon that combines a quick swing speed with good knockback potential. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.

Weapon:wid_sniper_invasion_railgun_vr_or.Name: WID_Sniper_Invasion_RailGun_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_sniper_invasion_railgun_vr_or.Description: A high tech rifle; charge it up to aim and fire a single powerful shot, great for dealing with enemies behind walls.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_sr_crystal_t0.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Light_SR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_blunt_tool_light_r_ore_t02.Description: Hardware: Light. A crowbar that combines a quick swing speed with good knockback potential. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_assault_smg_invasion_raygun_v.Name: WID_Assault_SMG_Invasion_Raygun_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_assault_smg_invasion_raygun_v.Description: This alien weapon emits a star-fueled laser blast.

Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_c_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Scythe_C_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_c_ore_t01.Description: Scythe: Improvised. A slow weapon that deals high damage and moderate impact. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_sr_crystal_.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Heavy_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_sr_crystal_.Description: Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_r_crystal_t04.Description: Axe: Light. A very fast improvised axe with fair damage and knockback. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_artdeco_vr_crysta.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_ArtDeco_VR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_sniper_tripleshot_sr_ore_t01.Description: Sniper Rifle: Burst. Fires accurate three-round bursts, dealing very high damage, but consuming ammo quickly.

Energy rifle that can be fired normally, or can be charged up to fire a single powerful shot that does extreme damage and can pierce through multiple enemies. Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_scope_vt_vr_c.Name: WID_Sniper_Standard_Scope_VT_VR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_pistol_zapper_sr_ore_t03.Description: Pistol: High Tech. Fires balls of energy that deal damage to enemies in a small radius. Deals energy damage that is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.

Weapon:wid_assault_auto_halloween_sr_ore.Description: Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. A spooky assault rifle that fires medium ammo, gaining damage and impact at the cost of accuracy and fire rate.

Weapon:wid_explosive_invasion_plasmacann.Name: WID_Explosive_Invasion_PlasmaCannon_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_explosive_invasion_plasmacann.Description: Launch a slow moving energy ball that zaps nearby objects and destroys any buildings in its path.

Weapon:wid_assault_scavenger_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Assault_Scavenger_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_assault_scavenger_sr_ore_t02.Description: Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. A versatile rifle that rewards careful aim with high headshot damage, but can be fired very rapidly in a pinch. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_explosive_shark_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Explosive_Shark_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_explosive_shark_sr_ore_t01.Description: Explosive Weapon: Grenade Launcher - Holiday Fun. Uses explosive ammo to lob bouncy toy shark grenades that damage groups of enemies in a moderate radius when they explode.

Weapon:wid_blunt_light_vr_crystal_t05.Name: WID_Blunt_Light_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_blunt_light_vr_crystal_t05.Description: Hardware: Light. A crowbar that combines a quick swing speed with good knockback potential. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_pistol_rapid_sr_crystal_t05.Name: WID_Pistol_Rapid_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_rapid_sr_crystal_t05.Description: Pistol: Semi-Automatic. Low damage and impact per shot, but able to fire very rapidly with large magazine and decent accuracy.

Weapon:wid_blunt_medium_ratrod_sr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Blunt_Medium_RatRod_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_blunt_medium_ratrod_sr_ore_t0.Description: Club: Medium - Rat Rod. A medium club with a good balance of damage and speed at the cost of lower impact. Home Run: Heavy attack focused on impact and a knockback that will send enemies flying.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_boombox_sr_ore_t.Description: Hardware: Boombox. A hammer with good attack speed and excellent impact. Bass Drop: Smash the ground, creating a series of sonic pulses that damage and knockback enemies.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_light_founders_vr.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Light_Founders_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_light_founders_vr.Description: Sword: Light. An extremely fast swing speed gives this blade great sustained damage, but minimal stagger potential. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_rocket_vt_sr_cry.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Rocket_VT_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_rocket_vt_sr_cry.Description: Hardware: High Tech. A rocket-powered hammer that delivers high knockback at a fast swing rate. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_pistol_sixshooter_uc_ore_t01.Name: WID_Pistol_SixShooter_UC_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_pistol_sixshooter_uc_ore_t01.Description: Pistol: Revolver. Fast, precise sidearm, with a good punch but small capacity.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_medium_vr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Medium_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_medium_vr_ore_t04.Description: Sword: Medium. Uses a fast attack speed to deal high sustained damage, with low knockback. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_edged_icesword_sr_crystal_t04.Name: WID_Edged_IceSword_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_icesword_sr_crystal_t04.Description: Sword: Medium - A very cool looking scimitar.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_ratrod_vr_crysta.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_RatRod_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_ratrod_vr_crysta.Description: Hardware: Medium - Rat Rod. A fast-swinging hammer that gains speed with each hit. Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_flintlock_bow_sr_ore_t.Name: WID_Sniper_Flintlock_Bow_SR_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Assault_SingleShot_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_hydraulic_sr_crys.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Hydraulic_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_hydraulic_sr_crys.Description: Sword: Hydraulic. A slow sword with powerful knockback. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.

Weapon:wid_assault_surgical_drum_founder.Name: WID_Assault_Surgical_Drum_Founders_R_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_blunt_medium_r_ore_t03.Name: WID_Blunt_Medium_R_Ore_T03

Weapon:wid_shotgun_vacuumtube_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Shotgun_VacuumTube_SR_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_boombox_vr_ore.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Boombox_VR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_pistol_vacuumtube_revolver_sr.Name: WID_Pistol_VacuumTube_Revolver_SR_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_medium_sr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Medium_SR_Ore_T03

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_heavy_vacuumtube_sr.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Heavy_VacuumTube_SR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_medieval_vr_ore_.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Medieval_VR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_sniper_amr_sr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Sniper_AMR_SR_Ore_T03

Energy rifle that can be fired normally, or can be charged up to fire a single powerful shot that does extreme damage and can pierce through multiple enemies. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_founders_vr_c.Name: WID_Sniper_Standard_Founders_VR_Crystal_T05

Weapon:wid_assault_semiauto_steampunk_sr.Name: WID_Assault_SemiAuto_Steampunk_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_pistol_ratrod_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Pistol_RatRod_SR_Ore_T04

Assault Weapon: Fully Automatic. Flexible assault rifle capable of handling all types of combat scenarios. High rate of fire with solid accuracy when aiming down sights and firing in controlled bursts.

"Don't worry, we'll give you a running start." - Ramirez

Weapon:wid_assault_military_auto_vr_ore_.Description: SMG: Military. Fast firing weapon with excellent damage output and magazine size, but lower range than most assault weapons. Maintains most of its accuracy while moving and firing from the hip, excelling at close range mobile skirmishes.

Weapon:wid_explosive_boombox_sr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Explosive_Boombox_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_explosive_boombox_sr_ore_t03.Description: Explosive Weapon: Boombox. Shoots a blast of sound that pierces enemies and bounces up to 5 times, dealing damage in an area with each bounce.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_dragon_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Dragon_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_dragon_sr_ore_t04.Description: Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high fire damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vacuumtube_vr_.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_VacuumTube_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vacuumtube_vr_.Description: Spear: Slow swing speed, high damage, and stun effects. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Light_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_light_sr_ore_t02.Description: Axe: Light. A fast-swinging improvised axe with moderate damage and knockback. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_sniper_flintlock_bow_sr_ore_t.Name: WID_Sniper_Flintlock_Bow_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_flintlock_bow_sr_ore_t.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Flintlock. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time. Arrow explodes after 2 seconds.

Weapon:wid_assault_boombox_sr_crystal_t0.Name: WID_Assault_Boombox_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_boombox_sr_crystal_t0.Description: Assault Rifle: Boombox. A higher than average impact assault rifle that fires two shot bursts at a steady rate and pierces enemies.

Weapon:wid_pistol_autoheavy_founders_vr_.Name: WID_Pistol_AutoHeavy_Founders_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_pistol_autoheavy_founders_vr_.Description: SMG. Fires at a very high rate, dealing great damage while consuming a lot of ammo. Good for run-and-gun combat, and accurate enough to fight at mid range when fired in short bursts.

Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_sr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Assault_SingleShot_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_sr_ore_t02.Description: Assault Weapon: Slug Gun. A rifle that fires slugs with high damage and impact. Good accuracy, but relatively slow rate of fire, and high per-bullet cost.

Weapon:wid_assault_raygun_sr_crystal_t05.Name: WID_Assault_Raygun_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_assault_raygun_sr_crystal_t05.Description: Assault Weapon: High Tech. A fully automatic laser gun with a quick rate of fire and decent accuracy. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_medieval_sr_or.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Medieval_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_medieval_sr_or.Description: Spear: Medieval. A spear that combines a good mix of damage and impact to deliver long range thrusting attacks. Joust: Charge forward, damaging and knocking back smaller enemies in your way.

Weapon:wid_assault_winter_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Assault_Winter_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_shotgun_vacuumtube_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Shotgun_VacuumTube_SR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_blunt_light_rocketbat_vr_crys.Name: WID_Blunt_Light_Rocketbat_VR_Crystal_T05

Weapon:wid_assault_auto_c_ore_t00.Name: WID_Assault_Auto_C_Ore_T00

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_ratrod_sr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_RatRod_SR_Ore_T03

Weapon:wid_assault_neonglow_vr_crystal_t.Description: Assault Rifle: Neon. Shoots highly accurate energized rounds at a moderate rate for high sustained damage. Deals energy damage, which is fairly effective against all types of elemental enemies.

Weapon:wid_explosive_rocket_winter_sr_or.Name: WID_Explosive_Rocket_Winter_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_explosive_rocket_winter_sr_or.Description: Explosive Weapon: Winter. Launches explosive presents that damage and knockback groups of enemies.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_retroscifi_vr_.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_RetroSciFi_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_retroscifi_vr_.Description: Spear: Retro Sci-Fi. A spear that deals heavy damage with long range thrusting attacks. Electric Smash: Slam the spear into the ground, damaging surrounding enemies.

Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_r_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_SingleShot_R_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_singleshot_r_ore_t04.Description: Assault Weapon: Slug Gun. A rifle that fires slugs with high damage and impact. Good accuracy, but relatively slow rate of fire, and high per-bullet cost.

Weapon:wid_sniper_flintlock_scope_vr_cry.Name: WID_Sniper_Flintlock_Scope_VR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Sniper_Medieval_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_sr_ore_t05.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Medieval. A powerful rifle that fires piercing arrows that deal very high damage and impact. Be mindful that it only holds one shot and has no scope, requiring thoughtful skill.

Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_bow_sr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Sniper_Medieval_Bow_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_medieval_bow_sr_ore_t0.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Medieval. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range and velocity increase with charge time.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_burst_blackmetal_sr_o.Name: WID_Shotgun_Burst_BlackMetal_SR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_retroscifi_sr_or.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_RetroSciFi_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_retroscifi_sr_or.Description: Hardware: Retro Sci-Fi. A hefty hammer with low impact and high damage. Blackhole: Heavy attack that pulls husks towards the hammer before dealing damage.

Weapon:wid_troll_launcher_durability.Name: WID_Troll_Launcher_Durability
Weapon:wid_troll_launcher_durability.Description: Heavy Weapon. Launches explosive trolls - what more could you want?

Weapon:wid_pistol_bone_pistol_sr_crystal.Name: WID_Pistol_Bone_Pistol_SR_Crystal_T04

Weapon:wid_blunt_club_light_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Blunt_Club_Light_VR_Ore_T01

Weapon:wid_shotgun_boombox_drum_sr_ore_t.Name: WID_Shotgun_Boombox_Drum_SR_Ore_T05

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_pirate_sr_ore_t04.Description: Sword: Medium - Flintlock. A deadly cutlass that combines a good mix of damage and impact with exceptional crit. Best when paired with pistols. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_sniper_vacuumtube_bow_sr_ore_.Name: WID_Sniper_VacuumTube_Bow_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_sniper_vacuumtube_bow_sr_ore_.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bow - Vacuum Tube. Fires an arrow that drops over time. Damage, range, and velocity increase with charge time.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_stormking_sr_crys.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Stormking_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_stormking_sr_crys.Description: Sword: Storm King. The Storm King’s Horn, forged into a versatile sword. (Ground) Storm Wave: Heavy spin-slash attack that damages enemies in front of you. (Air) Storm Strike: Warp to the targeted enemy, dealing heavy damage.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_medium_r_ore_t02.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Medium_R_Ore_T02

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_light_founders_vr.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Light_Founders_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_light_founders_vr.Description: Sword: Light. An extremely fast swing speed gives this blade great sustained damage, but minimal stagger potential. Quad Chop: A series of heavy attacks that deal increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_assault_autodrum_teddy_sr_ore.Name: WID_Assault_AutoDrum_Teddy_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_assault_autodrum_teddy_sr_ore.Description: SMG: Mid ranged assault weapon with a high capacity magazine and a lateral kick. Its shooting profile makes it ideal for clearing groups of nearby enemies in mobile engagements.

Weapon:wid_pistol_silenced_christmas_sr_.Name: WID_Pistol_Silenced_Christmas_SR_Ore_T03

Fires a pair of Sonic Blasts that pierce enemies.
Boasts a large clip size with low recoil.
This Hot Mix will really get your feet moving.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_medieval_sr_ore_.Description: Hardware: Medieval. A hefty spiked hammer with high impact and a moderate attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_assault_auto_vt_vr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_Auto_VT_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_auto_vt_vr_ore_t04.Description: Assault Weapon: Energy Burst. Assault rifle that fires accurate bursts of highly damaging energy, with a significant ammo cost. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against all elemental enemy types.

Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_uc_ore_t02.Name: WID_Sniper_Standard_UC_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_sniper_standard_uc_ore_t02.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic. An accurate mid to long range rifle that deals good damage. Can be fired quickly in an emergency, but at significantly reduced accuracy.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_medium_vacuumtube.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Medium_VacuumTube_VR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_medium_vacuumtube.Description: Sword: A blade with a fast swing speed for great sustained damage. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies. Cut and Thrust: A series of three heavy attacks that cut twice and thrust once while moving forward.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_r_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Heavy_R_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_r_ore_t01.Description: Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_retroscifi_vr_or.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_RetroSciFi_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_retroscifi_vr_or.Description: Hardware: Retro Sci-Fi. A hefty hammer with low impact and high damage. Blackhole: Heavy attack that pulls husks towards the hammer before dealing damage.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_heavy_uc_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Heavy_UC_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_heavy_uc_ore_t01.Description: Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_pistol_auto_vacuumtube_sr_ore.Name: WID_Pistol_Auto_VacuumTube_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_auto_vacuumtube_sr_ore.Description: SMG: Fires a barrage of electrical sparks dealing great damage but at an extremely short range and consuming a lot of ammo. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.

Weapon:wid_pistol_scavenger_sr_crystal_t.Name: WID_Pistol_Scavenger_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_pistol_scavenger_sr_crystal_t.Description: SMG. Fires at a very high rate, dealing great damage while consuming a lot of ammo. Good for run-and-gun combat, and accurate enough to fight at mid range when fired in short bursts. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_ratrod_vr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_RatRod_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_ratrod_vr_ore_t0.Description: Hardware: Medium - Rat Rod. A fast-swinging hammer that gains speed with each hit. Leap Attack: Heavy attack that jumps to a target area, damaging and knocking down nearby enemies.

Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_laser_sr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Scythe_Laser_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_scythe_laser_sr_ore_t01.Description: Scythe: High Tech. A slow weapon that deals high damage and fair impact. Deals energy damage which is fairly effective against elemental enemies. Push and Swipe: Two-strike heavy attack with increased damage and knock back.

Weapon:wid_sniper_fleming_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Sniper_Fleming_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_fleming_sr_ore_t04.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Spec Ops. A powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_scavenger_sr_cr.Name: WID_Shotgun_Break_Scavenger_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_scavenger_sr_cr.Description: Shotgun: Double-Barreled. Deals heavy damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a very wide cone. Has extremely limited range, tiny ammo capacity, and a long reload time. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_dragon_vr_ore_.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Dragon_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_dragon_vr_ore_.Description: Spear: Heavy. Delivers high fire damage and moderate knockback and a slow attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

Weapon:wid_pistol_artdeco_sr_ore_t05.Name: WID_Pistol_ArtDeco_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_artdeco_sr_ore_t05.Description: Pistol: Art Deco.  A slow firing but heavy hitting pistol with a limited ammo capactiy.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vr_crystal_t05.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vr_crystal_t05.Description: Spear: Heavy. Delivers high damage and moderate knockback and a slow attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_edged_axe_heavy_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Axe_Heavy_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_axe_heavy_vr_ore_t01.Description: Axe: Heavy. Slow-swinging axe that deals high damage and knockback. Up and Over: A two strike heavy attack that deals significant damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_scavenger_vr_or.Name: WID_Shotgun_Break_Scavenger_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_shotgun_break_scavenger_vr_or.Description: Shotgun: Double-Barreled. Deals heavy damage and knockback to multiple enemies in a very wide cone. Has extremely limited range, tiny ammo capacity, and a long reload time. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_founders_vr.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Heavy_Founders_VR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_heavy_founders_vr.Description: Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone.

Weapon:wid_sniper_steampunk_sr_crystal_t.Name: WID_Sniper_Steampunk_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_sniper_steampunk_sr_crystal_t.Description: Sniper Rifle: Semi-Automatic - Steampunk. A relatively fast and powerful mid range sniper rifle.

Weapon:wid_launcher_wintergrenade_sr_ore.Name: WID_Launcher_WinterGrenade_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_launcher_wintergrenade_sr_ore.Description: Explosive Weapon: Lobs grenades that damage and knockback groups of enemies in a moderate radius.

Weapon:wid_assault_boombox_r_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_Boombox_R_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_boombox_r_ore_t04.Description: Assault Rifle: Boombox. A higher than average impact assault rifle that fires two shot bursts at a steady rate and pierces enemies.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_dragon_drum_vr_ore_t0.Name: WID_Shotgun_Dragon_Drum_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_shotgun_dragon_drum_vr_ore_t0.Description: Shotgun: Automatic. Slower firing automatic shotgun that deals fire damage in a wide but short range. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

Weapon:wid_assault_military_surgical_vr_.Name: WID_Assault_Military_Surgical_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_assault_military_surgical_vr_.Description: Assault Weapon: Precision Scoped - Military. A scoped assault rifle with high headshot damage and excellent stability. Effective at long ranges, but difficult to use up close.

Weapon:wid_explosive_invasion_plasmacann.Name: WID_Explosive_Invasion_PlasmaCannon_SR_Ore_T05
Weapon:wid_explosive_invasion_plasmacann.Description: Launch a slow moving energy ball that zaps nearby objects and destroys any buildings in its path.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_longarm_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Shotgun_Longarm_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_shotgun_longarm_sr_ore_t04.Description: Shotgun: Tactical. A high-end tactical shotgun capable of fast precision fire at medium ranges.

Weapon:wid_assault_scavenger_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Assault_Scavenger_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_scavenger_sr_ore_t04.Description: Assault Weapon: Semi-Automatic. A versatile rifle that rewards careful aim with high headshot damage, but can be fired very rapidly in a pinch. Reduced durability, but much cheaper to craft.

Weapon:wid_edged_sword_dragon_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Edged_Sword_Dragon_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_edged_sword_dragon_vr_ore_t01.Description: Sword: Heavy. A slower sword with high fire damage and moderate impact. Double Slash: Damages and knocks back enemies in a wide cone. Fire damage is effective against nature enemies, but weak against water enemies.

Weapon:wid_assault_hydraulic_drum_vr_ore.Name: WID_Assault_Hydraulic_Drum_VR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_hydraulic_drum_vr_ore.Description: Assault Weapon: Hydraulic. A slow firing high impact automatic rifle with a large magazine.

Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_heavy_founders_v.Name: WID_Blunt_Hammer_Heavy_Founders_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_blunt_hammer_heavy_founders_v.Description: Hardware: Heavy. A slow-swinging hammer with powerful knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_blunt_heavy_paddle_r_crystal_.Name: WID_Blunt_Heavy_Paddle_R_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_heavy_paddle_r_crystal_.Description: Club: Heavy. A large paddle with a slow swing speed and high knockback. Double Thwack: Heavy attack that damages and knocks back enemies in a wide forward cone.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_boombox_break_sr_crys.Name: WID_Shotgun_Boombox_Break_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_shotgun_boombox_break_sr_crys.Description: Shotgun: Boombox. Shoots sonic blasts at enemies in a mid-ranged cone, damaging and knocking them back. Maintains a good balance of fire rate, clip size, and reload time, exchanging some damage for excellent impact.

Weapon:wid_pistol_autoheavy_sr_crystal_t.Name: WID_Pistol_AutoHeavy_SR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_pistol_autoheavy_sr_crystal_t.Description: SMG. Fires at a very high rate, dealing great damage while consuming a lot of ammo. Good for run-and-gun combat, and accurate enough to fight at mid range when fired in short bursts.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_hydraulic_vr_c.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_Hydraulic_VR_Crystal_T05
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_hydraulic_vr_c.Description: Spear: Hydraulic. Delivers moderate damage and very high knockback at a slow attack speed. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes.

Weapon:wid_sniper_fleming_sr_crystal_t04.Name: WID_Sniper_Fleming_SR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_sniper_fleming_sr_crystal_t04.Description: Sniper Rifle: Bolt-Action - Spec Ops. A powerful and accurate rifle with a bolt-action mechanism that results in a reliable but slow rate of fire. Shots can pierce through multiple enemies.

Weapon:wid_pistol_gatling_vr_ore_t02.Name: WID_Pistol_Gatling_VR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_pistol_gatling_vr_ore_t02.Description: SMG: Special. Absurdly fast-firing SMG with a large magazine that dishes out ridiculous damage at short to mid-range. Offset by poor accuracy, extreme ammo consumption, and a brief spin-up time before firing.

Weapon:wid_blunt_light_sr_ore_t04.Name: WID_Blunt_Light_SR_Ore_T04
Weapon:wid_blunt_light_sr_ore_t04.Description: Hardware: Light. A crowbar that combines a quick swing speed with good knockback potential. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_hydraulic_sr_ore_t03.Name: WID_Shotgun_Hydraulic_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_shotgun_hydraulic_sr_ore_t03.Description: Shotgun: Hydraulic. Very accurate pump shotgun that can reliably hit targets at medium range. Deals high impact but moderate damage at a slow fire rate.

Weapon:wid_assault_invasion_pulserifle_v.Name: WID_Assault_Invasion_PulseRifle_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_assault_invasion_pulserifle_v.Description: Fully Automatic when hip-fired, slower shots and extra headshot damage when aimed down sights.

Weapon:wid_blunt_medium_r_ore_t01.Name: WID_Blunt_Medium_R_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_blunt_medium_r_ore_t01.Description: Hardware: Medium. A heavy wrench with a moderate swing rate and good knockback. Overhead Smash: Heavy attack that does increased damage and knockback.

Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vacuumtube_sr_.Name: WID_Piercing_Spear_VacuumTube_SR_Ore_T02
Weapon:wid_piercing_spear_vacuumtube_sr_.Description: Spear: Slow swing speed, high damage, and stun effects. Whirlwind Attack: Heavy attack that spins around several times damaging and knocking back nearby foes. Deals nature damage that is effective against water enemies, but weak against fire enemies.

Weapon:wid_shotgun_steampunk_vr_ore_t01.Name: WID_Shotgun_Steampunk_VR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_shotgun_steampunk_vr_ore_t01.Description: Shotgun: Double-Barreled - Steampunk. Fires two slugs with reasonable accuracy and range, but has tiny ammo capacity and a long reload time.

Weapon:wid_pistol_bolt_vr_crystal_t04.Name: WID_Pistol_Bolt_VR_Crystal_T04
Weapon:wid_pistol_bolt_vr_crystal_t04.Description: Pistol: Bolt Semi-Automatic. Rapidly fires high-powered bolts that can pierce through multiple enemies.

Weapon:wid_assault_autodrum_teddy_sr_ore.Name: WID_Assault_AutoDrum_Teddy_SR_Ore_T03
Weapon:wid_assault_autodrum_teddy_sr_ore.Description: SMG: Mid ranged assault weapon with a high capacity magazine and a lateral kick. Its shooting profile makes it ideal for clearing groups of nearby enemies in mobile engagements.

Weapon:wid_explosive_rocket_winter_sr_or.Name: WID_Explosive_Rocket_Winter_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_explosive_rocket_winter_sr_or.Description: Explosive Weapon: Winter. Launches explosive presents that damage and knockback groups of enemies.

Weapon:wid_sniper_primal_stinkbow_sr_ore.Name: WID_Sniper_Primal_StinkBow_SR_Ore_T01
Weapon:wid_sniper_primal_stinkbow_sr_ore.Description: Fast-firing bow that unleashes a cloud of Stink on impact.
